desc: Ideate and select the row/column parity reduction with a parity DSU as the primary approach.
Implement and validate the row/column parity DSU solution in Python: sample outputs 2,0,2 and small brute-force checks pass.
Ensure performance for T up to 1e5 and sum HW up to 1e6: O(HW α(H+W)) time, lazy DSU allocation, bytes-based input.
